description: Looks up a domain registration over RDAP at the registry for its TLD: when it expires, the registrar, the statuses (flagging a hold, redemption, pending delete or pending transfer) and the nameservers. Subdomains are looked up by their registered domain (www.example.co.uk becomes example.co.uk).

domain.description: A public domain name, like example.com. A URL also works: only its host name is used.

name: check_domain_expiry
title: Check a domain registration expiry
